articles.title: Pentagon Insiders Call BS on Hegseth’s Big Project
articles.description: Military experts are skeptical that Pete Hegseth’s new robot-powered defense initiative will actually materialize anytime soon. Hegseth, 46, announced the creation of the Autonomous Warfare Command, also known as “AUTOWARCOM,” during his “State of the Force” address at Marine Corps Base Quantico in Virginia last month. The new military combatant command (COCOM) is supposed to tackle the rapid adoption and acquisition of autonomous and robotic assets for the joint force at large. Read more at The Daily Beast.
